title: PGIMER Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 13 Assistant Professor Posts
description: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 13 Assistant Professor Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MD/ MS can grab this chance and apply for the PGIMER Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, and salary structure. Education details, the application fee, and how to apply for these Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply offline before the last...
